cells.terminal_only: each cell's terminal attempt (D11.3: the first with a completed model exit); infrastructure attempts are not checked or counted

answer_source.description: answer_source agrees with the events and result.json: resubmit iff a submission_accepted event follows the review (submitted = it); first_submit after a review with a submit_review_resolved event (exit Submitted, submitted = the first submission) or for a first submission at the last call (review_skipped_last_call); none without a submission

config_receipts.description: result.json config and the episode_setup event's config are the arm's record

next_response_recorded.description: each requested response after a review has exactly one parsed_actions or format_error event

notice_receipts.description: the A1 final_turn_notice receipt is consistent (as the A1 dev check reads it)

records.description: each terminal attempt: its directory names its cell and attempt, result.json binds attempt_start.json and events.jsonl (sha256 and rows), its run_id is run.json's, and no attempt follows it

request_bytes.description: the review content is the reviewed call's tool result in every later request (with the deadline suffix when it is the message the notice follows) and in no earlier request; the ledger header never occurs in a neutral run, and in a ledger run only from the request after the review

review_event.description: at most one submit_review event, before the last call, for the first well-formed submission; reviewed iff it exists; the event, the receipt and the frozen text agree (text and content sha256, first submission, ledger entries/candidates/bytes and caps); the reviewed call's model-visible tool result is the event's content

review_receipts.description: result.json exposure.submit_review equals accounting.submit_review and the episode_finished event's, has exactly the receipt fields, mode = the arm and before_call_index 7

run_complete.description: every LEDGER cell at seed 61 in cells.jsonl is terminal in the D11.3 sense (a completed attempt, or missing after 3 infrastructure attempts)

run_json_cells.description: cells.jsonl is the file run.json binds (cells_sha256)

run_json_episode_config.description: run.json episode_config is the arm's exact record (the six prereg fields, the deadline notice, submit_review = the arm and submit_review_rules; no evidence ledger)

selection.description: every dispatched cell is a LEDGER|<item>|vcomplete or omit_node|C1|s61 cell of cells.jsonl

go_rule.rule: at least 90% of the reviewed episodes whose next response was requested answered it with a well-formed tool call (parsed_actions, not format_error)
